posts.text: Got my first PRs merged into Snap's open source 👻 Valdi is Snap's cross-platform UI framework. I fixed a bug in Valdi Widgets where text fields overflowed their containers on web, then migrated 25 test files to their newer testing API Thanks to Beau Collins for the reviews! Excited to do more OSS work in the near future!

Pretty stoked to be joining Meta next summer as a Production Engineering intern! Thanks to all the people who took the time to mock with me during the process: Ethan Rong, William Liu, Robert Xing, and many more! See you in Seattle!
Worked really hard on this with the whole team over the past 7 months! Apply Apply Apply!

Won Cloudflare and Linq's track at Hack the North! What we built: Whim, your group chat's agent. It plans dinner, splits the cart, and makes whatever game you want to play for all the times the plan DOESN'T make it out of the gc. Thanks to Cloudflare and Linq for the support and for pushing us on the idea and shout out to my teammates Jack Ruttan Sheng Chang Li and Karan!
Wow these guys are really awesome and have a super awesome hackathon hackwestern.com
